title: Medication-Review Visits by Formulary Status of Recent Fills — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Schedule — medication-review visits on a single specialist referral, Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

Medication-review visits are added to a single specialist referral's visits, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied, according to the member's paid pharmacy fills under the **Pharmacy Benefit** with a fill date in the medication window of **3 months**:

- a member with a specialty-tier fill adds the two-visit medication allowance (**2** visits);
- a member with no specialty-tier fill but with a preferred-brand or non-preferred fill adds the one-visit medication allowance (**1** visit);
- any other member adds nothing.

The medication window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a fill is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its fill date from the handling date, so a fill dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

| Formulary status of the member's paid fills in the last 3 months | Medication-review visits added |
|---|---|
| At least one specialty fill | 2 |
| No specialty fill; at least one preferred-brand or non-preferred fill | 1 |
| Only preferred-generic or covered over-the-counter fills, or no fill | 0 |

**Examples (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026)**

- A specialty fill on 2 August 2026 and a preferred-brand fill on 20 August 2026: the specialty fill decides, 2 visits.
- A non-preferred fill on 1 September 2026, no specialty fill: 1 visit.
- A specialty fill on 15 June 2026 (exactly 3 months back, outside) and a preferred-generic fill on 1 September 2026: 0 visits.
